description: This source file implements functions and classes for retrieving and managing Windows DNS system settings, including reading registry values, adapter DNS addresses, and DNS configuration details.

classes.name: RegistryReader
classes.description: Helper class for reading registry values (strings and DWORDs) from specified registry keys.

classes.name: WinDnsSystemSettings
classes.description: Class encapsulating Windows DNS system settings, including DNS addresses, registry configurations, and DNS policies.

classes.name: WinDnsSystemSettings::DevolutionSetting
classes.description: Struct representing DNS devolution settings with optional enabled and level parameters.

methods.name: ReadWinSystemDnsSettings
methods.description: Function to read and assemble Windows DNS system settings, including registry values and network adapter DNS addresses.

methods.name: WinDnsSystemSettings::IsStatelessDiscoveryAddress
methods.description: Static method to determine if an IPv6 address is a stateless discovery address based on its prefix.

methods.name: WinDnsSystemSettings::GetAllNameservers
methods.description: Method to retrieve all DNS nameserver endpoints from network adapters, filtering out specific addresses.
